entries.title: A local model can now discover and call the publication tools
entries.summary: A standards-compatible MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint exposes server-side counterparts of the four browser WebMCP tools. The included Ollama runner prints every discovery, tool call, and result; inspection is open, while activation still requires a signed delivery artifact that the bridge cannot mint.

entries.title: Claim relationships gained typed, inspectable resolution
entries.summary: The editor can propose exact replaces, narrows, confirms, or conflicts links against known prior claims. The server validates those targets, human release remains mandatory, and local retrieval resolves the approved links deterministically while retaining displaced claims in audit history.

entries.title: Install, VS-Bench, Signal Log, and explicit supersession moved into the product
entries.summary: Velvet Signal gained first-class install, benchmark, and product-history destinations, focused three-claim retrieval for weaker models, and deterministic claim supersession before ranking.

entries.title: Llama 2 7B applied a retrieved current food-safety update
entries.summary: The stale local model correctly treated five refrigerated days as beyond the retrieved 3–4 day cooked-leftover window. One sentence still contradicted a retrieved discard rule, so claim fidelity was scored partial rather than hidden inside a generic pass.

entries.title: Dolphin 3:8B proved local patch persistence across restart
entries.summary: After the terminal was closed and reopened, Velvet Signal retrieved pantry-003 again from the local ledger. The model itself did not need conversation memory for the update to survive.

entries.title: Semantic retrieval found a relevant claim with zero lexical overlap
entries.summary: For the five-day cooked-chicken prompt, pantry-003/P-08 ranked through embedding similarity even though its lexical score was zero, demonstrating retrieval beyond keyword matching.

entries.title: Local Ollama RAG memory bridge merged
entries.summary: Approved patches can persist in a user-controlled local ledger, retrieve active claim-level context with Ollama embeddings or lexical fallback, and inject provenance-preserving context into a local chat model.

entries.title: Updates since last visit added to the newsstand
entries.summary: Returning readers can distinguish newly published editions from issues they have already seen instead of manually comparing a small catalog.

entries.title: OpenRouter provider fallbacks enabled
entries.summary: The pinned editorial model can use compatible provider fallbacks rather than failing the entire publication path when the preferred provider is unavailable.

entries.title: Velvet Signal launch shelf went live
entries.summary: Six desks launched with human-readable editions and inspectable machine patches. Public desks use bounded source packets; Your People remains manual and consent-gated.
